motion.name: playback-amplitude
motion.purpose: Settings closed: original speech orb. Settings open: horizontal bars, never wider than the call button. Shared real playback amplitude; reduced motion keeps both still.

components.name: Conversation primary action
components.description: Start/end/return-stop action using the existing conversation lifecycle.
components.css: .conversation-call { background: var(--accent, #436a57); color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 22px; min-height: 50px; font: 600 16px Inter, sans-serif; } .conversation-call:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #345442); } .conversation-call:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2d713c); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Quiet conversation workspace with rich green accents and an opened settings inspector. Applies only to Conversation.
keyCharacteristics: Centered single-column conversation with settings closed
dos: Preserve all existing functions and gates
Use black text in the voice selection field
donts: Do not move hardware during UI checks
Do not restore the removed control workspace
